sentences.text: It is the case of the petitioner that she was appointed as Assistant Tourist Information Officer on 19.02.2011 pursuant to a selection process.
She was, thereafter, promoted to the post of Tourist Information Officer on 11.02.2019.
The petitioner, as such, was working since the day of her appointment.

However, on 15.05.2025, an FIR was lodged by the Inspector of Police, Chief Minister's Special Vigilance Cell, Assam stating, inter alia, that the selection process for the post of Assistant Tourist Information Officer in the year 2010 was vitiated on a number of counts.

entities.text: Chief Minister's Special Vigilance Cell, Assam
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Mr. S Borthakur submits that the person who has stated that he should be appointed is actually an ST(H) for which no reservation is provided for in the selection process, whereas, the petitioner is an ST(P) candidate and she was rightly appointed as per the selection process.

Mr. P Kotoky, learned counsel appearing for Chief Minister's Special Vigilance Cell, Assam submits that the allegations are very serious and that the petitioner worked illegally in the said post since the day of her appointment and as such, no bail should be granted to the petitioner at this stage.

entities.text: Chief Minister's Special Vigilance Cell, Assam
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: I have heard both the parties at length and on the bare perusal of the FIR as well as other documents which were annexed by the petitioner, it is seen that the petitioner has been working since 2011 and was promoted in 2019 without any blemish and without any complains, whatsoever.

Although the allegations in this FIR filed on 15.05.2025 are very serious, but, since, the length of her service as a Tourist Information Officer was quite long and there was no complain in between, this Court grants her interim bail on furnishing a bond of Rs 25,000/- (Rs Twenty Page No.# 3/3 Five Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Agency.

The Interim Bail is subject to the following conditions :
(1) She shall co-operate with the Investigating Agency.
(2) She shall appear within 7(seven) days from the receipt of the order before the Investigating Officer for recording her statement.
(3) She shall not leave the territorial jurisdiction without prior permission of the Investigating Agency.
(4) She shall not directly, indirectly make inducement, threats, promise to any person acquainted with the case.
(5) She shall deposit his passport/visa, if any, in the Investigating Agency.
(6) She shall not hamper with the investigation or tamper with the evidence.
(7) She shall co-operate with the investigation.
Call for the Case Diary.
List the matter on 28.06.2025.
